histaminePlans.scopeBasis: Continuation row has a blank applicability cell; no species exemption inferred. Explicit scope confirmation required.

findings.title: Histamine species condition spans processed products
findings.detail: The original page 12 applicability cell spans rows 1–10, while the stored core attaches it only to row 1. Fish Pickle continues on page 13 with a blank cell; the draft conservatively requires explicit species/scope confirmation there too. No species exemption is inferred from a processed-product name.

findings.title: Histamine needs all nine individual results
findings.detail: The mean must not exceed m, no more than two results may exceed m, and none may exceed M. A mean alone or a single result cannot establish that the source sampling plan is satisfied.

findings.title: Fish contaminant units and analyte groups stay distinct
findings.detail: PCB limits use ppm and the sum of six specified congeners; Benzo(a)pyrene in smoked fishery products uses ppb. Biotoxin row-specific units and toxin-equivalent expressions override the generic column heading; Brevetoxin mouse units are not silently converted to mass units.

findings.title: Melamine clause numbering resolved by original corrigendum
findings.detail: The 31 March 2016 corrigendum changes 2.4/2.4.1 to 2.5/2.5.1 and names the Second Amendment Regulations. Powdered infant formula, liquid infant formula and other foods retain distinct values; the broader other-foods value cannot replace an infant-formula value.

findings.title: Saffrole replacement remains future until 1 December
findings.detail: The 2026 notification replaces the whole serial-number-4 entry with an ingredient-qualified article. The existing six 2015 articles are not carried forward automatically or replaced early. The draft source comparison refuses assessment dates on or after 1 December pending reconciliation.

findings.title: Sago/cassava hydrocyanic-acid row has its own source
findings.detail: The 21 July 2017 notification inserts a 10 ppm row for the named sago/flour articles and their products. It is separate from the five 5 ppm articles in the 2015 table; the higher value cannot be selected solely because a confectionery recipe contains starch.

reviewBoundary.scope: Original-source concordance for these layers and a separate draft histamine comparison gate. Not exhaustive current-law, product or lot approval. Species names are source literals, not a taxonomic correction; genus and common-name aliases are not invented.
